subject: Post-renewal capacity harmonization and one-time settlement
messages:
From: Nora Patel <nora@nimretail.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-renewal capacity harmonization question

Hi Markus,

Hope you're well — quick note from our finance team as we were closing books for May. After the renewal last month we saw a retroactive consumption adjustment for April that triggered a one-off invoice (INV-8791). The spike appears to be from an unanticipated inference batch run tied to a feature experiment (we're still investigating internally).

Tom (cc'd on future replies) asked whether Redwood can offer a smoothing or amortization option for that one-time charge — ideally splitting it across two upcoming invoices — because the number wasn't budgeted. Also asking whether there's a way to reconcile the raw token/hour breakdown you have so we can present it to our procurement committee.

I've attached the usage export we pulled (small sample) and the AP team wants to confirm payment terms before we process. Can you advise what options we have for settlement or credit?

Thanks,
Nora Patel
Director, Cloud Ops
Nimbus Retail
Attachments: Nimbus_usage_Q2.csv (sample), INV-8791 (received invoice)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Nora Patel <nora@nimretail.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>; Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-renewal capacity harmonization question

Hi Nora — thanks for the note and for attaching the usage extract. I'm sorry for the surprise; we want to make this easy to resolve.

Short answer: yes — we can propose a couple of paths depending on whether you want a billing credit, a time-limited amortization, or a one-off payment with a small waiver. I'll let Laura (billing) share the exact numbers and draft settlement options. Naomi (CS) and I will stay engaged to make sure the technical breakdown is clear for your procurement committee.

To help speed things up, Laura: can you validate the invoice lines and share a proposed settlement matrix (credit vs amortize over 2 invoices vs net30 with 10% waiver)? Nora/Tom: if you can confirm which option you'd prefer we can draft the amendment and get DocuSign moving.

Best,
Markus Klein
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Nora Patel <nora@nimretail.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Post-renewal capacity harmonization question

Hi Nora / team — I've pulled the invoice and matched it against our token/hour logs for the April spike. Summary below: 

- Invoice: INV-8791 (one-off charge) — $18,450.00
- Root cause: transient 24-hour batch job on 2027-04-16 that consumed a high number of generation tokens due to misrouted traffic.
- Verified usage lines and attached the detailed CSV for your records (Nimbus_usage_Q2.csv).

Settlement options (proposal):
1) Amortize across next two invoices: 50% on June invoice, 50% on July invoice — no additional fee.
2) One-time payment with 7% operational waiver applied, due Net30 (effective charge $17,174.50).
3) Apply a one-time credit of $4,000 (partial goodwill) and amortize remainder over one invoice.

We recommend option 1 if you prefer predictable budgeting. Option 2 is simplest for AP (single payment). Option 3 reserved for cases where the spike is partially attributable to platform issues (we didn't find a bug, though we can continue the technical postmortem).

Next steps: if you confirm the preferred option, we'll issue an amendment/credit memo and (if amortizing) update the upcoming invoice schedule. I attached a draft settlement workbook that shows how each option impacts your next three billing statements (Settlement_Proposal_20270530.xlsx) and re-attached the invoice PDF for audit (Invoice_INV-8791.pdf).

Laura Bennett
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Settlement_Proposal_20270530.xlsx, Invoice_INV-8791.pdf, Nimbus_usage_Q2.csv

From: Nora Patel <nora@nimretail.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 11:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-renewal capacity harmonization question

Hi Laura / Markus — thanks for the fast turnaround and the clear options. After a quick internal check, Procurement leans toward amortizing over two invoices (option 1) to avoid a large one-time hit to the operational budget. Neutral on goodwill; if your postmortem shows a platform attribution we may revisit.

Two asks before we confirm: 
1) Please provide a token/hour breakout per day for the affected week (2027-04-12 to 2027-04-19) so our SREs can cross-check against our job scheduler.
2) Can Redwood publish the amortization as a credit memo line item called "Capacity Harmonization Credit (INV-8791)" so our AP team can match it to the PO? They prefer visible line items for reconciliation.

If we get (1) and (2) before EOD Monday we'll sign off and process the first amortized invoice on schedule.

Thanks — Nora
